scientific_hypothesis.statement: With total-goals probability held fixed, exact-score shape contains predictive information in the pre-match variability of how xG opportunity share is allocated between the two teams. A fixture-specific Beta-Binomial goal-allocation concentration estimated only from earlier home-role and away-role xG-share histories can improve exact-score calibration relative to the frozen global concentration while preserving total-goal and 1X2 semantics.

share_state.share_definition: home_xg_share=h_xg/(h_xg+a_xg) for historical matches with positive total xG
share_state.chronology: ONLY source matches with kickoff strictly earlier than target kickoff; same-kickoff excluded
share_state.validity: estimate valid only when 0 < sample_variance < mean*(1-mean) and kappa is finite positive
share_state.source_combination: equal arithmetic mean of independently resolved home-team-home and away-team-away kappa estimates

goal_allocation_generator.total_goals_anchor: every frozen V3.1.1 total-goals marginal is retained exactly
goal_allocation_generator.home_share_anchor: p = frozen V3.1.1 expected_home_goals / frozen V3.1.1 expected_total_goals; p=0.5 only if expected_total_goals is numerically zero
goal_allocation_generator.conditional_distribution: For each total T, H|T follows Beta-Binomial(T, alpha=kappa*p, beta=kappa*(1-p)); only cells inside the frozen finite square support are retained and renormalized within each T slice
goal_allocation_generator.reference_matrix: frozen total-goals marginal multiplied by the dynamic Beta-Binomial allocation within each total slice

constraints: preserve every frozen V3.1.1 total-goals marginal exactly
preserve frozen V3.2.4 target H/D/A probabilities exactly
constraint_projection.algorithm: deterministic iterative proportional fitting alternating total-goal slices and H/D/A partitions

application_scope.non_switch_matches: H/D/A remains frozen V3.1.1 while score shape may change
application_scope.v3_2_4_switch_matches: H/D/A equals frozen V3.2.4 target while score shape comes from the dynamic concentration reference

forbidden: changing the concentration estimator after scoring
changing source weights or fallback hierarchy after scoring
using target result labels to fit concentration
manual match team league fold score or cell exceptions
